hints.title: Feasibility Monotonicity
hints.text: If it is possible to make m bouquets on day D, it is certainly possible on any day greater than D.

hints.title: Search Space Range
hints.text: The answer lies between min(bloomDay) and max(bloomDay). If m * k exceeds the total flowers available, return -1 immediately.

hints.title: Verification Function
hints.text: On candidate day mid, greedily count consecutive bloomed flowers. Every group of k bloomed flowers yields one bouquet.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing day by day incrementally can take up to 10^9 days, exceeding time limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search on the monotonic answer space reduces time to logarithmic iterations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks total flowers capacity edge case and implements greedy adjacent grouping correctly.
complexity.notes: Watch out for integer overflow when computing m * k in 32-bit languages.
